title.en: Active Mobility (Excepted Use, etc., of Non-Compliant Mobility Vehicles, etc.) Regulations 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Active Mobility (Excepted Use, etc., of Non‑Compliant Mobility Vehicles, etc.) Regulations 2026 and come into operation on 1 June 2026.

heading.en: Excepted driving or riding of non‑compliant mobility vehicle

text.en:
3. For the purposes of section 20(1)(d) and (2) of the Act, an individual may drive or ride on a public path a non‑compliant mobility vehicle of any model or description if —
(a)the maximum speed that the mobility vehicle is capable of reaching under any circumstances does not exceed 10 kilometres per hour; and
(b)the individual —
(i)has been granted a valid certificate from a specified assessor certifying that the individual has a medical need to drive or ride that mobility vehicle;
(ii)has, before 27 February 2026, received a subsidy under the Seniors’ Mobility and Enabling Fund for the purchase of that mobility vehicle; or
(iii)has, whether before, on or after 1 June 2026, received a subsidy under the Assistive Technology Fund for the purchase of that mobility vehicle.

heading.en: Excepted use of non‑compliant non‑motorised wheelchair

text.en: 4. For the purposes of section 20(2A) of the Act, an individual may use on a public path a non‑compliant non‑motorised wheelchair of any model or description if the individual has been granted a valid certificate from a specified assessor certifying that the individual has a medical need to use that non‑motorised wheelchair.
